instruction: Fix `split_words` so it splits on any whitespace run (the current code splits on a single space, leaving empty tokens for multiple spaces).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/parselib.py b/parselib.py
--- a/parselib.py
+++ b/parselib.py
@@ -76,4 +76,4 @@
 
 def split_words(text):
     """Split ``text`` on whitespace into words."""
-    return text.split(" ")
+    return text.split()
